SA - Scrimmaging and Half Guard - Whizze.overview: Gordon Ryan on the underhook-versus-whizzer battle, which happens both in half guard and in standing scrambles, eight volumes (the folder's contents file has timestamps). Volume 1 covers core concepts (jiu-jitsu versus wrestling, push-pull theory, hooking the leg, the battle of the knees). Volume 2 covers attacking from the underhook (killing the whizzer, cutbacks, roll-throughs, knee taps, body lock). Volume 3 covers winning the scrimmage (pull-throughs, running to the far hip, pinning versus stuffing, the back/pin dilemma). Volume 4 covers advanced control and leg entries (far hook insertion, knee down to knee tap). Volume 5 covers entering ashi garami and pinning the leg. Volume 6 covers the overhook (whizzer) side. Volume 7 covers advanced counters and scrambles. Volume 8 is live rolling.
SA - Scrimmaging and Half Guard - Whizze.for: No-gi players who end up in underhook / whizzer battles from half guard or standing.
key: Cutbacks, knee taps and body locks
sources: Course Content - Whizzer Vs Underhook.txt in the course folder

Sambo The Top Game - A Blue Print For Sm.overview: Khabib Nurmagomedov's sambo-based top game, three parts. Part 1 covers standing techniques (his takedown set-ups). Part 2 covers ground techniques: smashing the legs, riding and keeping the opponent down. Part 3 covers cage techniques (taking down and holding opponents against the fence) for MMA.
Sambo The Top Game - A Blue Print For Sm.for: MMA fighters and no-gi grapplers who like heavy top control.

Sathya “Bird” Wiltse Leveling Up Closed.overview: Sathya 'Bird' Wiltse's closed guard course, five parts; it's gi-focused despite the catalog's earlier no-gi tag (it includes gi grip fighting and cross collar chokes). Part 1 covers drills and exercises (the closed guard squeeze drill and others). Part 2 covers armbar variations from closed guard, including flipping them from a stacked armbar. Part 3 covers grip fighting from top and bottom and cross collar chokes. Part 4 covers the double ankle sweep and the prybar overhook series. Part 5 covers the omoplata (including the kick-out back take).
Sathya “Bird” Wiltse Leveling Up Closed.for: Gi closed guard players at all levels.
key: Armbar variations and beating the stack
Grip fighting and cross collar chokes
Double ankle sweep and prybar overhook
